card.text: Explore Neptune in 3D with cssEarth. Discover the distant blue ice giant, its turbulent atmosphere, faint rings, and orbiting moons.

introduction.text: Neptune is the eighth and most distant planet from the Sun: a cold blue ice giant with a turbulent atmosphere.

normal.title: OPAL visible-color map
normal.summary: Colors approximate visible cloud patterns. North of about 30° N, an illustrative cap replaces missing observations.

methane.title: OPAL FQ619N map
methane.summary: False colors show 619 nm reflectance. North of about 30° N, missing coverage is filled from its boundary, not measured.

near-infrared.title: OPAL F845M map
near-infrared.summary: False colors show 845 nm reflectance. North of about 30° N, missing coverage is filled from its boundary, not measured.
